name: hatch-codogotchi
description: Codex-native skills that draw Codogotchi-compatible sprite atlases (Codex, Lite-Basic, Lite-Enhanced, and Son-of-Anton tiers) from a seed image, a text description, or an existing Codex sheet.

interface.longDescription: Hatch Codogotchi bundles five guided, slot-first skills plus a Python pipeline: prepare_pet_run.py emits a deterministic per-row prompt (8 invisible 4x2 slots, never 'grid/cells', so image_gen paints one continuous flat field) plus a reference-only layout-guide.png that carries slot placement, centering, and safe margins as a picture; it also auto-selects ONE chroma key for the whole pet (the canonical magenta/blue/green farthest from the seed palette, magenta fallback) and recolors reserved accents — the success checkmark and the dead-state ghost — so nothing collides with the chosen key. image_gen draws each row, slice_grid.py shares one scale and emits an exact 1536x208 strip, compose_atlas.py stacks the WebP atlas, then slim QA (dimensions, slots, static-row detection, contact sheet, GIF previews). Chroma keying is intentionally left to the user via the dedicated Codogotchi Studio web tool (codogotchi.app/studio). Produces Codogotchi-compatible sprite atlases for the required Codex Tier-1 sheet, the Lite-Basic and Lite-Enhanced alive/dead tiers, and the Son-of-Anton delivery-gate sheet.
defaultPrompt: Hatch a new Codogotchi pet from this seed image
Add the Lite-Basic spritesheet to my existing Codex pet
Generate the Son-of-Anton gate spritesheet for my pet
